title: Complete `defaults.rs` — real database seeding
objective: INCOMPLETE FEATURE (not dead code): defaults.rs (117 lines) defines default/template prompt constants but seed_database() is an Ok(()) no-op. COMPLETE it: implement seed_database() to insert the documented default prompts into storage idempotently, de-duplicate the template constants to a single source, and wire seeding into the init path (e.g. `prompthub init --seed` / PromptHub bootstrap). Upgrade only — finish the seeding feature; do not remove the module.
acceptance_criteria: seed_database() actually inserts the default prompts into storage (idempotent on re-run)
seeding is reachable from a real entry point (init/bootstrap)
a test seeds then reads the defaults back
policy_note: Owner directive 2026-06-13: NO DOWNGRADES. A module that looks like dead code / an old feature is an INCOMPLETE feature to be completed — never removed or gated out. Upgrade only.
resolution: COMPLETED the seeding feature in defaults.rs (NO removal): seed_database() is no longer a no-op — it now takes (&PromptHub, &AgentIdentity), builds the six base role templates via new default_prompts() (each a Prompt tagged default/base-template with its primary role in target_roles), and registers any not-already-present (matched by name via hub.list) through the normal RBAC+sanitize+audit register() path. Idempotent: a second call inserts 0. Template constants kept as the single source (templates mod); base_template_specs() maps name->role->const so there is no duplication. Wired into a real core entry point: added pub PromptHub::seed_defaults(identity) façade method delegating to defaults::seed_database. Tests (in defaults.rs): default_prompts_cover_all_base_templates; seed_database_inserts_all_base_templates (seeds 6, reads back via list); seed_database_is_idempotent (6 then 0); seed_database_requires_write (anonymous -> Unauthorized). seed_database had ZERO external callers, so the signature change broke nothing. Gates: cargo test -p prompt-hub defaults => 9 passed (--all-features); clippy --all-features --all-targets -D warnings clean; default clippy (lib) clean; default-features library build (CI default-build gate) green; cargo fmt --check clean. CLI `init --seed` shell wiring is prompthub/** scope (out of this card's prompt-hub/** path_scope) -> filed PHTASK-0042. Done via worktree loop/phtask-0039-get-rbac-test (cycle 90).
